brief_rationale: The doctor safely addressed all eight responsibility-chain items, effectively distinguished COVID-negative results from lupus nephritis status, and prevented medication self-adjustment. No serious or minor in-chain errors occurred, and four high-order points (HO1–HO4) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, satisfying the strict full-credit boundaries for a trajectory that met RC1–RC8, all five dimensions at good/excellent, and two or more high-order points, with no important non-chain defect.

closure_assessment.explanation: The final exchange provides a detailed, time-bound plan with specific actions, responsible owner, and contingency for red flags; the family confirms they will follow the plan, measure blood pressure, and bring all required materials, making the closure safe, traceable, and valid.
